topic: 60 years of mom's life resurrected from photo albums
new_body_text: 60 years of someone's life, **pulled out of faded photo albums**
new_caption:
This is the kind of thing AI was made for.

Sixty years of someone's life, pulled out of faded photo albums and turned into something she can actually feel again — all because her son decided that was the gift worth giving.

Most AI demos are about replacing things. This one is about returning things.

Follow @metawareai for more.
